name: Ikemma
source:
You don't remember him. Your companions say he is pure evil; a foreigner using dark magic to terrorize the islanders. No one has ever seen him, yet they know endless tales of his cruelty. Like the tales you hear about yourself, they don't seem real.

[From [url=https://maneki-mushi.itch.io/theherosjourney]itch.io[/url]]
